steps.sub: which query, what "slow" means, when it happens

steps.label: Measure
steps.sub: duration, CPU, logical reads, the actual plan

steps.label: Isolate
steps.sub: the one operator or wait actually driving cost

steps.label: Hypothesize
steps.sub: a specific, falsifiable guess about the cause

steps.label: Change
steps.sub: exactly one change that tests that hypothesis

steps.label: Verify
steps.sub: re-measure the same metrics against the baseline

steps.label: Document
steps.sub: problem, change, before/after — for next time

eyebrow: Why one change at a time
code:
Bundled deployment:
  + new index
  + rewritten subquery
  + MAXDOP 4
  -> faster... but which one worked?

Isolated deployment:
  + new index only
  -> measured, confirmed, documented
  -> next change tested on its own
caption: Bundling destroys your ability to learn what actually helped.
